T. Maria rosary shibora

Bangalore : 7598252113

: icborani@gmail.com

CAREER SUMMARY

Results-driven Investment Banking Operations professional with 9 years in securities services and hedge fund reconciliation. Specializes in client relationship management and operational risk control for institutional clients in APAC and Hong Kong. Manages high-volume reconciliation and trade support, leads client escalations, and drives service delivery improvements. Committed to process automation and operational transformation to enhance efficiency.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

JP Morgan Chase, Bangalore - Team Leader - Feb 2022 - Present

Manage end-to-end operational delivery for institutional clients ensuring strict SLA adherence and operational accuracy.

Manage trade processing across repo, mortgage-backed securities (MBS), TBA, collateral and fund-of-fund transactions.

Served as Client Lead for assigned funds, managing client expectations and ensuring service quality standards are consistently met.

Resolved non-operational escalations, addressing trade failures, break investigations, and complex cross-currency trade issues to maintain operational integrity.

Led governance discussions with onshore teams and senior stakeholders, focusing on operational performance metrics and risk management strategies.

Ensure adherence to internal controls, audit requirements and operational risk frameworks.

Led initiatives to automate processes and improve efficiency across operations.

Process Automation



Implemented automation initiatives using Alteryx and Frodo templates significantly reducing manual intervention.

Reduced processing turnaround time from 10 minutes to 2 minutes and from 4 hours to 45 minutes.

Automated client blotter reporting improving turnaround time and data accuracy. • Translate operating model changes into clear communication for clients and internal stakeholders.

Enhanced CAID processing to achieve consolidation of positions across clients and regions.

Tata Consultancy Services, Bangalore - Team Leader – Feb 2021 - Feb 2022

Managed client-facing trade operations including booking, amendments, approvals and issue resolution within agreed SLAs.

Collaborated with clients, settlements teams, and risk management teams to resolve trade



exceptions and operational issues, enhancing overall transaction integrity. Identified and escalated operational and reputational risks, facilitating timely resolutions and safeguarding organizational reputation.

Enhanced Straight-Through Processing (STP) rates by strengthening static data governance and controls.

Key Achievements

Successfully on-boarded two clients simultaneously within 90 days under tight deadlines. • Migrated numerous manual accounts to automated platforms within 5 months improving operational efficiency.

Automated monthly reporting decks saving 12 hours of manual effort globally. • Delivered process simplification initiatives resulting in 1.5 FTE operational efficiency gains.

State Street HCL Services (P) Limited, Coimbatore - Senior Analyst - 2016 to 2021

Executed daily cash and position reconciliation across multiple prime brokers and internal accounting systems to ensure accurate financial reporting.

Analyzed and resolved reconciliation breaks across equities, FX, swaps, repos, and OTC,Swift instruments, enhancing operational efficiency.

Ensure timely reconciliation of delivery within strict intraday deadlines while maintaining high accuracy levels.

Conducted break analysis using Bloomberg and internal systems coordinating with brokers and operations teams.

Worked on SWIFT messages, Nav Calculation, Fund Accounting • Oversaw multi-currency accounting entries, including income accruals, interest postings, and expense allocations, ensuring compliance with financial standards.

Awards and Achievements



Best Senior Analyst for high-quality performance.

CERTIFICATION

NISM module VII - Securities Operations and Risk Management Certification Examination.

ACADEMIC

KV Institute of Management and Information and Studies, Coimbatore

MBA with Finance and HR

May 2016
